config.errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name: connector.errors
config.neo4j.topic.cypher.cpg.edges: MATCH (source:CodeNode {node_id: event.source_id}), (target:CodeNode {node_id: event.target_id}) MERGE (source)-[r:CPG_EDGE {edge_id: event.edge_id}]->(target) ON CREATE SET r.edge_type = event.edge_type, r.properties = event.properties ON MATCH SET r.properties = event.properties
